diagnosis: The line_items action queries PayrollLineItem.objects.filter(batch_id=pk) directly using pk from the URL without invoking self.get_object(). While PayrollBatch list and retrieve are scoped by company, any authenticated user can query salary line items of another company's payroll batch.
exploit_request:
GET /api/payroll/batches/892/line-items/ HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.accounting-saas.com
Authorization: Bearer <company_a_jwt>
